question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"appeared."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb** "appeared"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • This implies that the subject in question was not previously visible or known, but has now become visible or known. • The word **"appeared" **means to seem. (प्रतीत होना, लगना) • **Example**: *She **appeared**__ to be a magician to me.* • This option is grammatically correct and makes sense in the given context. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct passage**: The Grim Reaper seems to have __**appeared**__ in Europe during the 14th century. It was during this time that Europe was dealing with what was then the world’s ______ (2) ______ pandemic, the Black Death, believed to be the result of the plague. It is estimated that about one-third of Europe’s entire population ______ (3) ______ as a result of the pandemic, with some areas of the continent suffering far greater losses than others. The original outbreak of the plague occurred during 1347–51, and outbreaks then ______ (4) ______ several other times after that. So, clearly, death was something that the surviving Europeans had on their mind, and it is not surprising that they ______ (5) ______ an image to represent it. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "found"**, implies that the subject was lost and then subsequently located. (किसी संगठन, संस्‍था आदि की स्‍थापना करना) • **Option 3, "rested"**, implies that the subject was previously active or moving and has now stopped to rest. ((सक्रिय रहने या बीमारी के बाद) सुस्‍ताना; सोना या आराम करना) • **Option 4, "died"**, implies that the subject is no longer alive. (मरना, प्राण त्‍याग करना) 44:Tf60, The correct answer is **"worst."**
